verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents deploying browser agents that run on a recurring schedule or on demand. Agents can be created from the dashboard by describing a goal in natural language, can run continuously and alert you when something breaks, and webhooks report status changes without polling. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules (cron syntax, recurrence options, failure/retry handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Run agents that click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks.
Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
